items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Bioengineering, Molecular Biology, Cell Biology, or Genetics and/or equivalent training/experience. (Required)
Extensive experience with droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) and data interpretation.
Experience writing and editing SOPs or quality reports.

The Research Associate collaborates with a research team conducting molecular analysis of genome editing outcomes using droplet digital PCR (ddPCR) and other advanced assay-based techniques. This role involves the maintenance and expansion of sensitive mammalian cell lines, including iPSCs, and the execution of core molecular biology protocols to validate CRISPR-based therapeutic interventions. The Research Associate collaborates with a research team developing next-generation CRISPR-based therapeutics using various delivery techniques including, ribonucleoprotein (RNP) delivery approaches. Projects in the lab focus on engineering and delivering genome editing systems to treat diseases such as Huntington’s disease, pediatric glioma, and sickle cell disease. Under supervision, the position assists with molecular biology techniques including cloning, protein and RNP preparation, cell culture, and genome editing assays, as well as evaluating delivery efficiency in relevant cell types. Supports laboratory operations, including preparing reagents, maintaining organized records, and assisting with experimental workflows. The role will contribute to research activities under a supervisor’s guidance while supporting the lab’s mission to develop accessible and effective genetic therapies.
Conducting ddPCR and dPCR assays to benchmark and evaluate gene editing efficiency, including the quantification of indels, excisions, and inversions.
Maintenance and characterization of mammalian cell cultures, with a specific focus on iPSCs and HSPCs.
General molecular biology tasks, including genomic DNA extraction, long-range PCR, and agarose gel electrophoresis.
Data management, interpretation of results, and reporting findings in team meetings.
General laboratory support, including the preparation of peptide solutions and equipment maintenance.
Proficiency in mammalian cell culture techniques.
Standard molecular biology skills, including DNA extraction and PCR optimization.
Familiarity with and/or ability to learn CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing workflows and validation.
Strong data analysis skills using and/or ability to learn Microsoft Excel, R, or Python.
